topics.name: MCP to Tool Registry Boundary
topics.purpose: Define the explicit validation/registration boundary by which an MCP-advertised capability may become a runtime tool under `#T`.

semantics.identity_rule: Canonical #T tool identity is explicit and distinct from MCP advertisement identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Registered tool retains exact endpoint+advertisement provenance.
semantics.registration_rule: Registration is an explicit operation and never a side effect of MCP discovery.
semantics.state_rule: registered, available, enabled and invocable are separate states.
semantics.authority_rule: Registration does not grant callers invocation authority.

invariants.rule: MCP endpoint identity, advertised capability, validated #T tool identity, concrete invocation and returned result are separate identities; advertisement or availability never grants execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: advertisement id reused as canonical tool identity without explicit mapping
changed MCP capability silently replaces validated binding

references.purpose: Only validated advertisements may cross into #T.
#T owns validated runtime tool registry identities.
